Type: stool
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Swivel Kitchen Dining Room Counter/Bar Stool, Adjustable 26 Inch-30 Inch Height, Brown Wood
Colors: Brown
Materials: wood
This barstool is high-style industrial and versatile as well. The seat adjusts from counter height to bar height with a few simple turns. Natural color variations in the wood seat make each one uniquely beautiful. The base is made of durable metal. 17.75" Diameter. Height adusts from 26"-30." Solid wood and metal Adjustable height allows this stool to work with a counter or bar Assemble in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
